highlights.title: Hideout games inside Deadlock
highlights.text: Hideout games show up in Custom Match in Deadlock's Play menu. Pick one, invite friends and host it without leaving the game.

highlights.title: Friends' invites in game
highlights.text: When a friend invites you, it pops up in Deadlock. Press Esc, then Join.

new.text: Stop or Leave a Hideout game from Deadlock's Esc menu. If you leave a game that's still running, Rejoin puts you back in.
When you join a game, Deadlock shows each step until you're in, and says why if joining fails.
Hideout asks once before it adds its games to Deadlock. You can turn them off any time in Settings.

improved.text: Installs are faster, most of all with many mods, because a new mod no longer renames the files of the mods after it.
Moving, removing and repairing mods finish sooner, because Hideout reads each mod file fewer times.
Hideout does less work when it looks for a running Deadlock and when it checks your mods against the game.
In a narrow window, Library's buttons move under the title instead of squeezing it.
The import preview shows each mod's cover.
Mods in your game folder that the other manager doesn't list still come along. The import preview shows them under Already in your game.
Grimoire profiles come over with all their mods, and empty Deadlock Mod Manager profiles come over too.

fixed.text: Windows no longer stops your game to ask about Hideout's game server. It asks before Deadlock starts, and either answer works.
Import no longer offers Grimoire on a computer that doesn't have it.

highlights.title: Favourites
highlights.text: Star the mods you like. Turn on Favourites in Browse or Library to see just those.

highlights.title: See what a mod needs
highlights.text: If a mod needs another mod to work, its page lists it so you can install it in one click.

new.text: No more 99 mod limit. Deadlock only loads 99 files from one folder, so Hideout now uses more folders and everything you turn on loads.
Mods left in your game folder by another manager show up in Library. Add them or move them out.
Keep both in File priority, for mods that are meant to change the same files.
If a Deadlock update or a Steam file check unloads your mods, Hideout loads them again and tells you.

improved.text: Downloads keep going through short outages.
If a mod file goes missing, Hideout puts it back from your backups before you play.
Backups take a lot less space. They skip GameBanana mods you removed and download them again if you restore.

fixed.text: Hideout no longer looks blurry on Windows with display scaling above 100%.
Clicking a button twice no longer hits the next mod too.
File priority says which mod is off.
Install counts versions, not parts, when a download has several versions.

highlights.title: First release!
highlights.text: Hideout installs mods from GameBanana and hosts custom games your friends join with a code. Thanks for trying it.

highlights.title: Skins in 3D before you install
highlights.text: Open a skin to see it in 3D. Drag to turn it, and play its animations and abilities.

new.text: Host a custom game and send your friends a code or a link. Hideout gets the mode for them and puts them in your game, with no ports to forward.
The custom games so far are Bebop Wars, Rooftop Rally, Pillars and Shattered Arena. They're new and still being tested.
Install mods from GameBanana, and update them from Library when their authors post a new version.
Each profile has its own mods turned on and its own load order.
Copy a share link for a profile. A friend opens it, or pastes it into Import from link when making a new profile, and gets the same mods in the same order.
When two mods change the same files, File priority lists the files they share and which mod wins.
Bring your mods over from Deadlock Mod Manager or Grimoire, with your profiles, crosshair and autoexec. Their load order and on or off state come along.
Pick a crosshair the community made, or make your own.
Edit autoexec.cfg from a library of commands. The lines you wrote by hand stay.
Your match history, heroes and rank, from deadlock-api.com.
When a Deadlock update breaks a skin, Hideout repairs what it can and keeps the original files. Skin repairs are experimental.
Mature mods show with their pictures blurred. Turn on Hide mature mods in Settings to leave them out.
Play vanilla starts Deadlock without your mods. Backups put back your mods, their order, your profiles, autoexec.cfg and your crosshair.
Save a bug report from Settings › About. It's a text file with your setup, your mods and what Hideout did recently, without your user name.
Hideout updates itself. A new version downloads in the background and installs when you restart.
